srowlink

components · 0.1.1 · E6 · aj-c-srowlink

A settings row: label, value, and one sentence of explanation. Carries its own flat fill, because the value is --rule-2 and the row often sits on the open graph ground. Top-aligned, so the value sits with the label. (The checkable option, .opt, shares inventory row E6 but is the composer's and the entry memory menu's; it is converted with the composer.)
